label: daily-json-detected-level-aligned
description: sum by (detected_level) over a JSON pipeline (row evaluator, and the stats pushdown with the level computed in VictoriaLogs and its guard probes). DLV7 is DLV3 over a 30s range, shorter than the 60 s step of the 24h range, so the daily run measures a range shorter than the step (semantics/json-metric-step-wider-than-range); at 1h and 6h its range is longer than the step.
